Thanks for flagging. I support both accommodations — please add the 25m break after pairing and confirm live captions in Zoom (embedded) so all panel members can see them. Brief interviewer notes:

- Systems design (45m): focus on high-level tradeoffs: state sharding, KV-cache strategies for large seqs, and how you'd handle tail-latency on cross-traffic. Keep the first 10m as whiteboard/clarifying questions.
- Pairing exercise (50m): candidate will share screen. We want to observe debugging approach more than final code.
- Please do not introduce surprise system constraints (e.g., no network access) — callouts like that make it hard to evaluate accessibility changes.
